title: Shisha Cloudz – Mango Grape 100ml
description:
Shisha Cloudz – Mango Grape 100ml
Mango Grape by Shisha Cloudz e-liquids is a traditional Malaysian fruity vape concoction featuring two CLASSIC flavours!
Sweet, sweet mangoes and purple grapes along with classic Shisha notes make this a must-have in your Shisha vape rotation!
Shisha Cloudz e-juices come with 0mg nicotine level and a 70VG/30PG ratio.
